scripts.lint: eslint apps packages tests scripts infra --no-warn-ignored
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages tests scripts infra *.json *.yaml .github
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages tests scripts infra *.json *.yaml .github
scripts.dev: pnpm build && concurrently -k -n api,worker,console "pnpm --filter @ozz/api dev" "pnpm --filter @ozz/worker dev" "pnpm --filter @ozz/console dev"
scripts.api:generate: pnpm --filter @ozz/api... build && node --env-file=.env apps/api/dist/openapi.js && pnpm --filter @ozz/api-client generate && pnpm --filter @ozz/api-client build
scripts.test:unit: vitest run && pnpm --filter @ozz/console test:unit && pnpm test:manual-data
scripts.test:integration: pnpm build && node --env-file=.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm db:generate && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:unit
